title: add RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent examples that demonstrate tool-calling (HTTP API, search, and code execution), and corresponding quickstarts and docs site updates. Motivation: Make it easier for developers to onboard with RAG + agent patterns using Redwood: reproducible templates, runnable examples in both Python and TypeScript, andDocs site quickstarts so teams can copy/paste and adapt to their infra.

What this PR contains: - examples/rag/: new folder with 3 opinionated RAG templates (faq-bot, docs-assistant, and legal-review) and sample corpus + ingestion helper. - examples/agents/: agent examples that show tool definitions and tool-calling patterns (search, http-fetch, run-code) in Python and TypeScript. - sdk/python/quickstart_rag.py and sdk/typescript/examples/agent-tool-calling.ts quickstart scripts that wire the templates to the Redwood API and a local vector store. - docs/quickstarts/rag.md and docs/agents/tool-calling.md: Quickstart guides with step-by-step setup, recommended model/quantization profiles for Dedicated/Hosted, and troubleshooting tips. - site/content/docs/quickstarts/rag/index.mdx: Docs site content with embedded code snippets and a sequence diagram (site/static/assets/rag-diagram.svg). - tests/examples/test_rag_quickstart.py: Integration test that exercises the python quickstart against a small mocked vector store.

Backward compatibility and rollout: All changes are additive; no breaking API changes. Examples are optional and gated behind the examples/ directory. Docs updates link to existing SDK auth guidance.

Notes on security and data: The ingestion example includes guidance for PII redaction and KMS integration in the docs. The sample corpus is synthetic and marked clearly as test data.
